hero_subtext: One habit a week, stacked. By day 28 you're doing all four without thinking about it. No equipment, no cost, no all-or-nothing energy — miss a day, tick the next one.

weeks.title: Move
weeks.description: 10 minutes of intentional movement every day. Brisk walk, dance in your room, cycle to class, take the stairs. Get slightly out of breath.

weeks.title: Fuel
weeks.description: Keep week 1 going. Add: one plant (fruit, veg, beans, nuts) to every meal, and swap one sugary or energy drink a day for water.

weeks.title: Recover
weeks.description: Keep weeks 1–2. Add: a consistent sleep window on at least 5 nights, and screens down 30 minutes before bed.

weeks.title: Lock in
weeks.description: All three together. Plus one session of movement with a friend — a walk, a gym trip, a kickabout. Social habits stick harder.
